integrity: Self-contained proof and standalone reproducibility checks; no independent mathematical verification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only ordinary, world-deleting truthful announcements of a fixed static epistemic formula (no common knowledge); empty model is an absorbing terminal convention. Computational checks are finite corroboration, not proof of infinite claims. A related BPAL valuation-type lemma is prior work; an older equivalent PAL formulation cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp one-agent alphabet bound and two-agent divergence for repeated truthful announcements
